# OpenAPI validation schema

Official OpenAPI 3.1 schema downloaded from
https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2022-10-07 on 2026-09-26.
Stored unchanged so tests do not fetch network resources. This schema validates
the OpenAPI document shape; tests separately compile its JSON Schema references.
